description: v0.9 First Boot remains usable without a model provider or network namespace and reports the exact bounded QualificationEnvironment with lifecycle status derived from the exact-source build version.

steps.name: verify-firstboot-qualification-environment
steps.command:
version=$(linuractl version | awk '{print $2}'); if [ "$version" = 0.9.0 ]; then expected_status=release-qualified-experimental; else expected_status=candidate-not-yet-release-supported; fi; output=$(linura-firstboot --qualification-environment); printf '%s
' "$output" | grep -Fx 'id=qualification/ubuntu-24.04-lts/amd64/qemu-tcg-headless' && printf '%s
' "$output" | grep -Fx 'base_image_sha256=d1940f7d69d343355e183dff1e08a59852d32e7309baa7a4bad8365b11b005ac' && printf '%s
' "$output" | grep -Fx 'kind=qualification-environment' && printf '%s
' "$output" | grep -Fx "status=$expected_status"
